articleTitle: Bitcoin price prediction in the time of COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Based on the Bitcoin exchange data, COVID-19 data, and Twitter data from January 2020 to July 2020, this paper compares the performance of four different machine learning models on predicting the Bitcoin return rate and price trend. Data are formulated to four input feature sets, including: (1) Historical Bitcoin exchange data; (2) Historical Bitcoin exchange data + COVID-19 data (recovery, confirmed, death); (3) Historical Bitcoin exchange data + Twitter data; (4) Historical Bitcoin exchange data + COVID-19 data (recovery, confirmed, death) + Twitter data. The four machine learning models implemented are: (1) Random forest; (2) Decision tree; (3) AdaBoost; (4) Support vector machine. We found that: (1) Twitter data can improve the performance of models; (2) People consider information within 5 days when they make decisions on investments; (3) Support vector machine does not perform well in predicting Bitcoin return rate or price trend; (4) COVID-19 data does not help improve the prediction. However, we have very limited COVID-19 data, so future research with more COVID-19 data may help confirm if the last statement is correct or not.

articleTitle: Detection of Anomaly Stock Price Based on Time Series Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Anomaly detection is a critical task for financial market, investors, and regulatory authorities, where conventional methods employ rule-based models. With the development of machine learning and deep learning techniques, it becomes more promising to detect anomalous trading behaviors from data. Here we present a deep learning model based on time series LSTM model to detect anomalous behaviors in Chinese stock market. The model is composed of 1dConv-LSTM neurons, which can predict time series stock price data from historical data. We analyzed the price of 14 stocks variations ranging from 2015/01/05 to 2019/12/31 and used univariate and multivariate time series models to generate MAE less than 4.0 consistently. The proposed method improved MSE to 0.0171 on validation datasets. Our model successfully predicts the anomalous price behaviors of `601318' stock in the range of 2019-02-13. Our method provides an automatic way of predicting anomaly stock price behavior in Chinese stock market.

articleTitle: A study of day-ahead scheduling strategy of demand response for resident flexible load in smart grid
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the steady increase of the resident electricity load in China, the flexible load represented by smart home appliances also increases gradually. In this paper, resident flexible loads are classified according to different modes of load demand response, and corresponding detailed demand response models of load electrical equipment are established. A day-ahead scheduling strategy of demand response (DR) for resident flexible load in smart grid is proposed. The proposed strategy system makes full use of the detailed electricity consumption data of resident users and performs stochastic optimal scheduling of resident load demand response with high error accuracy. For the power grid, it can effectively reduce the peak load, peak valley difference and total load power consumption. For the residents, it can effectively reduce the electricity cost with less influence on their comfort. In addition, it also provides strong support for urban resident load demand response decision under the condition of smart grid.

articleTitle: Sustainability and Artificial Intelligence: Necessary, Challenging, and Promising Intersections
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Both digital economy and digital technology researchers increasingly recognize the need to better address the role that artificial intelligence (AI) plays in shaping the evolution of the environmental, social and governance aspects of development. It appears that sustainability and AI research converge on the features of wicked problems that are complex, interconnected and dynamic. Building off such convergence, this article aims to map out the necessary, challenging, and promising intersections by providing an overview of the state of art research. Based on 541 bibliographic data collected from the Web of Science (WoS) database, the findings reveal the increasingly central body of work on green and sustainable science and technology in bridging various disciplines, main journals and key topics and concepts. The findings reveal how such interactions can be necessary, challenging, and promising. The article concludes with few general arguments regarding how to diversify and expand the community of practice regarding AI for sustainable development, especially in the areas of expected AI application areas and institutions.

articleTitle: Demand response analysis of large electricity consumer based on load response model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The load fluctuation of large electricity consumers is large and the planning is easy. It is a good object of demand response program. To analyze the demand response potential of large electricity consumers, this paper develops the load response model of large electricity consumers under time-of-use electricity price. In addition, this paper finds that under the reasonable demand response program, with the increase of consumer participation rate, power system will have better performance on peak load shaving and valley filling. In order to further analyze the potential of large consumers to participate in the demand response program, this paper introduces three evaluation indexes: demand response ability, demand response speed and peak load reduction rate. Finally, the changes of comprehensive demand response potential of consumers under different peak valley ratios and different elastic coefficients. The results can provide certain reference for related research.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling strategy of adjustable load based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In recent years, the number of flexible loads on the demand side is increasing rapidly. Adjustable loads participate in the flexible interaction of the power grid, which not only improves the overall energy efficiency of the power grid, but also reduces the electricity cost of users. In this paper, the optimal dispatching strategy of the adjustable load resources participating in the power grid interaction is studied. Firstly, the optimal regulation model of adjustable load is constructed, which takes the minimum operation cost of the system as the objective and considers the constraints of power balance and adjustable load regulation. Then, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to calculate the model, and the optimal scheduling scheme of each group of devices in the scene is obtained. Finally, a microgrid with captive power plant and energy storage system is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed optimization model.

articleTitle: Tourism Industry is Leading the Digital Transformation of Cultural Heritage Management : Bibliometric Analysis Based on Web of Science Database
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The sustainable development of cultural heritages management requires the increase of the public on their awareness of the status and values related to the cultural heritages, and tourism development in a scientific and reasonable way has become one of the most effective ways for the protection and sustainable development of cultural heritages. With the aim to reveal the research fronts and topics of such potential development, this paper conducted a bibliometric analysis based on 535 related articles from the Web of Science (WoS) database. This paper introduces the research results with respect to the publishing trends, main publication outlets and topics, and main keyword groups. As found in the analysis on the research results, the tourism industry has become the main carrier of the digital transformation of cultural heritage management, and digital technology tools such as 3D technology, laser technology, geographic information technology, database modelling and other new technologies have provided important guarantees for the risk management, monitoring, planning and visualization of cultural heritages, digital technologies such as database management system. Such digital transformation is guided by the tourism industry under the purpose of sustainable development, and hence, the tourism industry has become the main driving force for the sustainable development of cultural heritages.

articleTitle: Mapping the Field of Educational Assessment and Professional Accreditation in Higher Education: Bibliographic Coupling and Co-Citation Analyses for Green and Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Evaluating effectiveness and impacts of higher education has been the central sites of observations for the field of educational assessment and professional accreditation, with various institutions providing accreditation services such as IEET, HEEACT, AACSB, ABET, etc. Given the advancement of digital technologies and digital economy applications, it is important to explore how such higher education evaluation can benefit from, and also account in, such digital advancement. In this paper, we conduct web crawling written in Python to systematically scan the Web of Science to retrieve the related literature. Based on 646 bibliographic data collected from the database, the findings show that the main contribution has been made by mostly the three main disciplines: science education, educational research, and engineering, the top journals such as International Journal of Engineering Education, the top keywords such as accreditation, assessment, quality assurance, outcomes, etc. The findings also reveal how such concerns have been discussed in relation to topics such as learning analytics, big data, sustainability, impacts, etc., that can be related to green and digital transformation. In conclusion, the overall mapping provides an initial roadmap for the practice of higher education assessment and accreditation to harness the potentials of digital technologies for green and digital transformation of higher education, including more inclusive notion of "impact" that includes sustainability and more human-centered notion of "outcomes" that focuses more on human development.

articleTitle: How Can Blockchain Shape Digital Transformation: A Scientometric Analysis and Review for Financial Services
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: As a rapidly emerging and iteratively developed technology, the blockchain and its derived technologies evince promising revolution potential in the financial field. In this state-of-the-art-paper, we organized 1,361 literature from the web of science (WoS) database and analyzes their annual trend, topics, publications, and disciplines. Base on the exploratory scientometric analysis, we also mapping on co-occurrence clusters and demonstrate the possibilities and application areas in the related field. The study reveals after 2015, notions beyond "bitcoin" gradually occurs, and expand relevant topics to a new level. Their majority of topics are in the traditional business field and tend to be applied rather than technology or theory. Although "blockchain", "bitcoin", and "cryptocurrency" are correlative concepts, they are classified into different clusters, in which the red blockchain cluster is more capable of redefining financial services with digital resources. These insights will help future researchers understand the evolving state of blockchain technology and respond to digital transformation trend in a more effective way.

articleTitle: Towards the Convergence of Green and Digital Transformation of Creative and Cultural Industries : An Exploratory Bibliometric Analysis for Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: When digital technologies have disrupted creative and cultural industries, it becomes vital for organizations of arts, culture, and creativity to reexamine their business or operation models to change their practices. When climate change has been shaping the cultural attitudes and values, it becomes also relevant for the very organizations to adopt practices that advance both human and sustainable development. Thus, creative and cultural sectors need strategies to navigate the increasing need of green and digital transformation. To date, little research has been conducted on this topic, and thus this exploratory bibliometric analysis aims to fill the gap by a systematic review of the relevant literature. Based on 991 articles, this paper outlines the main areas of discussions and issues as well as the opportunities and challenges for research and policy innovations. The findings have revealed the significance of tourism, sustainability and Internet in the state-of-art literature, thereby highlighting the need for an integrated approach to green and digital transformation for creative and cultural industries. Future research can be conducted across different creative and cultural sectors, so as to allow researchers to generalize and construct the notion of smart and sustainable cultural consumption and production (SCP) as the timely and relevant contribution to the wider sustainable SCP literature.

articleTitle: Analysis of COVID-19 on Service Industry Based on Fama and French Five-Factor Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The Fama and French five-factor model was developed as an expansion of the previous Fama and French three-factor model, where the five-factor model included two additional factors profitability and investment to the existing three factors market, size, and value to better estimate the expected return of the security. As COVID-19 had negatively impacted the economy in the U.S., this study applied the Fama and French five-factor model to examine the performance of the service industry before and after the outbreak of COVID-19 using the dataset from Kenneth R. French Data Library and draw insight about the prospect of the service industry. The estimated coefficients as well as the t-statistics of the five factors for before and after the outburst of COVID-19 periods were computed and analyzed. The result showed that all five factors market, size, value, profitability, and investment were statistically significant during the COVID-19 period, with changes in some of the factors after the hit of the pandemic, revealing the return of service industry is associated with the five factors. Specificially, investors during this crisis and in the future should be more cautious toward service businesses that have smaller-cap, weak profitability and less investment activities.

articleTitle: Analysis on Financial Management of Small and Micro Enterprises Based on Cloud Accounting in Big Data Age
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the strengthening of national support for small and micro enterprises, the development speed of small and micro enterprises in the market economy is getting faster and faster. The arrival of the big data era has brought unprecedented business models to all enterprises in the market. Relying on data platforms and cloud computing platforms, small and micro enterprises can effectively solve their own economic development problems and constantly enhance their market competitiveness.

articleTitle: Supplier recommendation based on knowledge graph embedding
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Selection optimal suppliers is an important issue for supply chain management. Cloud manufacturing and other new digital manufacturing paradigms pose challenges to supplier selection due to high dynamic characteristics, but also in turn provide new opportunities for improving supplier selection by usage of data. Knowledge graph has been widely researched in recommendation system and achieved remarkable results. And knowledge graph will also play an important role in improving supply chain management. In this work, a novel approach is proposed to learning purchase demand-procurement records property specific and global relatedness from supply knowledge graph based on knowledge graph embedding. And then we use the relatedness features to predict top-N procurement records which are most related to purchase demand. Finally, we conduct a numerical example to demonstrate the practicality and effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Machine Learning Techniques for Stock Market Movement Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Financial market prediction is a classic problem in both academia and industry. This problem has attracted not only researchers in the financial community, but also many researchers in the computer science field. In recent years, many machine learning and deep learning models have been applied to stock market movement prediction with different horizons. This paper evaluates 18 machine learning and deep learning models for 3 stock indexes, predicts the movement of close price after 1, 5 or 10 days, and presents the detailed prediction results. This paper finds that the fully convolutional neural network has no obvious advantages over other machine learning models. And the 10-day movement is easier to predict, which would be useful for designing a long-term investment strategy.

articleTitle: Opportunities, Challenges and Promotion Countermeasures of Central Bank Digital Currency
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Blockchain is a shared ledger and database with distributed data storage, asymmetric encryption, consensus mechanism and intelligent contract as the core technologies. It has the characteristics of decentralized, tamper-proof, traceable and retrospective, collectively-maintained, open and transparent. Therefore, Blockchain becomes the bottom but also the most important technical means of Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC), which are organically combined and closely linked. This paper studies the opportunities and challenges of Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) issuance in the context of the rapid development of Blockchain technology, and proposes the main technical routes and countermeasures for CDBC: improving the management mechanisms, formulating CBDC standards and regulations; deepening international cooperation and actively innovating regulatory approaches to meet future challenges; focusing on technology empowerment, planning for protecting the rights and interests of financial consumers under new business models; strengthening data governance, building data transaction and privacy protection mechanisms. This study has reference value for the risk control, technology adoption and countermeasures in the process of issuing digital currency by central banks of all countries.

articleTitle: Current situation and development trend of 5G millimeter wave
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Millimeter wave is one of the main frequency bands of 5G. At present, the commercial use of millimeter wave has become a hot spot in the communication industry of various countries. This paper introduces the distribution of 5G millimeter wave spectrum in various countries and the latest status of 3GPP millimeter wave standard. The advantages and disadvantages of millimeter wave are very prominent, and the millimeter wave industry is facing severe challenges, especially in millimeter wave hardware devices. 5G millimeter wave not only supports non independent networking, but also supports independent networking. At present, the mainstream is non independent networking, followed by independent networking. The bandwidth and data download rate of millimeter wave is much higher than that of 5G sub-6. Millimeter wave is more revolutionary for 5G technology. Millimeter wave will become a new field supporting 5G's long-term hot application.

articleTitle: In the information environment, linear regression data was used to analyze the impact of m&a goodwill on the financial performance of manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In recent years, with the further development of economy and h the development of information, mergers and acquisitions of enterprises have become more and more frequent. The goodwill arising from business merger, an important indicator which was often ignored, has become increasingly prominent and attracted the attention of corporate leaders and investors. Taking manufacturing industry as a specific industry, this paper uses linear regression model to analyze the impact of goodwill on corporate financial performance<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sub> This will have a positive theoretical and practical significance for the evaluation of the target enterprise in the merger and acquisition negotiation, the payment method and the effective management of goodwill after the merger and acquisition.

articleTitle: Design of full-link digital marketing in business intelligence era with computer software Edraw Max
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: “Digital Intellectualization” is the general term of digital and intelligent concepts, and it is also a new stage of digital and intelligent development. This paper uses Edraw Max, a flow chart network drawing software commonly used by product managers, combined with the perspective of Alibaba cloud research center in 2019, to outline five dimensions of enterprise using computers to achieve digital marketing in the post-pandemic era: user insight, product production, sales strategy, logistics management and overall brand building. This design pays attention to the all-round penetration of computer digital technology into the marketing process, responds to the “fragmentation” of users with "full-links", opens up all links between users and enterprises, realizes the automatic docking of data before and after sales links, and helps enterprises to obtain self-optimization and upgrade of decision-making mechanisms. The author also combined recent real marketing cases to illustrate the inevitability of digital technology to promote full-link marketing, the feasibility of a new design framework, and the problems that have emerged in the current implementation of enterprises. Finally, comprehensive ecological sustainable development is put forward as an expectation in the conclusion of this article.

articleTitle: Development, Application and Trend of Artificial Intelligence in China’s Financial Field
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The development of financial technologies such as cloud computing, big data, blockchain and artificial intelligence (AI) is going deep into the core areas of the financial industry, promoting the intelligent development of the financial industry and exerting a far-reaching impact on economic and social life. This paper systemizes the current application of AI in the financial industry and its development trend. Besides, based on the features of the financial industry, several suggestions are put forward on the future development trend of intelligent finance.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Cluster Control of Electric Heating Flexible Load Adjustable Capacity
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: As a flexible and adjustable load, when its scale reaches a certain degree, is bound to become a considerable demand response resource in power grid operation. It is of great significance to bring it into power grid dispatching operation through demand response. In this paper, a thermal dynamic model of transient heat balance relation of electric heating is constructed, and an evaluation method of adjustable capacity of household electric heating load based on temperature prediction is proposed to evaluate the adjustable capacity of user electric heating load. A uniform clustering model of electric heating load parameters was established and its potential of regulating electric heating load clusters is analyzed. The results show that when the upper limit of the demand response temperature range is 22°C, the smaller the temperature value of negative regulation is, the larger the heat storage energy of cluster electric heating is, and the more significant the peak clipping effect of demand response is.

articleTitle: SWOT Analysis of the Business Model of Short Video Platform: Take Tik Tok as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Since the 21st century, with the development of society and the continuous upgrading of information technology, the scope of influence of technologies such as the Internet and cloud computing has become stronger and stronger. This paper uses the SWOT method to conduct an in-depth analysis of the business model of the research short video platform. First, the author conducted a comprehensive literature review, including business model related research, Internet cultural enterprise business model research and short video platform business model innovation research; based on the analysis of typical short video platform business model the model was analyzed by SWOT. In the future development, opportunities and challenges coexist. Based on the wide user base market in the short video industry, Tik Tok inevitably has to use its own advantages to achieve commercial realization. Currently, the monetization of Tik Tok e-commerce is being explored and improved. From an implementation point of view, the performance of video delivery is good, and live broadcast will become one of the important scenarios of e-commerce in the future.

articleTitle: Research on government subsidy, internal control and overinvestment in enterprises by multiple regression analysis method : Based on multiple regression analysis method
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In recent years, scope of Chinese government subsidy expands unceasingly and the excessive investment behavior of enterprises is increasing continuously. To study the inhibitory effect of internal control during government subsidies promoting overinvestment, taking Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share manufacturing listed companies from 2013 to 2018 as research samples, this paper adopts multiple regression analysis method to test the moderating effect of internal control on the influence of government subsidies on enterprises' excessive investment. I find empirical support for that government subsidies promote firms to overinvest, and good internal control can reduce the positive impact of government subsidies on overinvestment. Furthermore, in the enterprises with low product market competition intensity or no political connection, the regulating effect of the internal control is more significant.

articleTitle: Exploring the Drivers of Conscious Waste-Sorting Behavior Based on SOR Model: : Evidence from Shanghai, China
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: To help reduce pollution, the study proposes a novel approach, called conscious waste-sorting, and provides a theoretical framework based on the stimulus-individual-response (SOR) model. The structural relationship among environmental, personal, and behavioral factors is first proposed and then explored, which considers multiple influences including environmental pollution, mass media, social norms, self-monitoring, self-preference, self-efficacy, personal outcome expectation, and conscious waste-sorting. Then, the model is empirically analyzed using PLS structural equation modeling on a sample of Shanghai citizens collected from an online questionnaire survey. The results showed that social norms (β = 0.387, p <; 0.001) and self-monitoring (β = 0.433, p <; 0.001) had a positive impact on self-efficacy, which in turn, led to personal outcome expectation (β = 0.221, p <; 0.001) and conscious waste-sorting behavior (β = 0.412, p <; 0.001). Based on this observation, the study also develops strategies to strengthen the conscious waste-sorting behavior to protect the environment.

articleTitle: Research of Relationship Between Corporate Governance and Financial Performance Based on Multiple Regression Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In the financial market, the effectiveness of corporate governance is of great significance to the operation and future development of enterprises. It can effectively promote the prosperity and development of market economy, effective corporate governance mechanism can help enterprises grow rapidly, and promote the orderly and stable development of the whole financial field. At present, the research on the correlation between corporate governance and financial performance is not clear. Multiple regression analysis method is a statistical method to analyze sample data, which can effectively analyze the relationship between variables. In order to explore the relationship between corporate governance and financial performance, this paper uses multiple regression analysis method to establish a multivariate mathematical model between corporate governance and financial performance, and makes an empirical study on the relationship between corporate governance and financial performance, and puts forward the corresponding assumptions. In this paper, the GEM listed companies in China as the research object, empirical analysis. The results show that corporate governance is significantly related to financial performance. Corporate governance has an important impact on financial performance, and plays an important role in the future development of enterprises. Good corporate governance is conducive to the stability of the financial industry.

articleTitle: A Survey of Intelligent Optimization Algorithms for Weapon Target Assignment (WTA) Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In the research on firepower strike optimization of intelligent battlefield multi-weapon platform, in order to improve the overall strike effectiveness of weapons, it is necessary to establish a weapon target allocation model to obtain real-time and accurate strike plans, and obtain strike-related strike parameters through data model comparison. To this end, this article first introduces the concept, classification and basic mathematical model of the WTA problem, and sorts out the progress of the weapon-target assignment (WTA) problem at home and abroad. For the analysis of the WTA problem, you can use the genetic algorithm "survival of the fittest, survival of the fittest" mechanism, the particle swarm algorithm iterative process is simple and fast, and the ant colony algorithm has clear goals and strong scalability, etc. to obtain a precise strike plan to solve the problem of low real-time firepower strikes, The problem of low accuracy, finally pointed out the lack of horizontal comparison between the current WTA problem and the intelligent optimization algorithm research, and clarified the next development direction from the three perspectives of the feasibility, effectiveness and scalability of the WTA problem.

articleTitle: A Scientometric Analysis of User Experience Research Related to Green and Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: User-centered design enables the organization to focus on the needs of its customers and users while most of the industries are facing the imperative pressure of green and digital transformation due to the pandemic. Therefore, using design thinking and system thinking to guide both digital transformation and green transformation gains more significance under such circumstances. Still, there is no systematic review of how user experience advances green and digital transformation. The purpose of the article is to provide a cross-disciplinary groundwork of user experience design related to green and digital transformation. User experience certainly occurs at every stage of a digital project so that both the user and service producer can refer to the result of this literature review and build more contributions upon it. This systematic review of user experience design literature on the topic has summarized the annual trends since 1995, main research disciplines, and publication outlets based on a scientometric analysis of 250 articles collected from the Web of Science database. Future research can build upon the preliminary findings here for the methodological, information, and research need for tracking the development of user experience design that advances digital transformation.

articleTitle: Research on the integration of digital economy and real economy to promote high-quality economic development
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Digital economy is an economic form in which data is directly or indirectly used to realize rapid optimal allocation and regeneration of resources and achieve high-quality economic development. At the technical level, it includes emerging technologies such as big data, cloud computing, the Internet of Things, blockchain, artificial intelligence and 5G communications. At the application level, "new retail", "new manufacturing" and so on are its typical representatives. Based on the perspective of industry integration, this paper discusses the mechanism of digital economy and real economy integration to promote high-quality economic development. At the same time, combining with China's specific national conditions, this paper puts forward the idea of digital economy and real economy deep integration to promote high-quality economic development. It is believed that developing digital economy is an inevitable choice to achieve high-quality economic development.

articleTitle: Research on the Employees’ Continuous Knowledge Contribution Behavior in ESM from the Perspective of Uses and Gratifications based on python
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: [Purpose/Significance] As an emerging knowledge management platform, enterprise social media provides an important way for employees to exchange knowledge, communicate and collaborate within the enterprise. However, scholars have not paid enough attention to meet the needs of employees in the process of enterprise social media and make continuous knowledge contribution. [Method/Process] This study constructs a research model based on the use and gratifications theory, and explores the influence mechanism of enterprise social media employees' continuous knowledge contribution behavior. This paper uses python language to capture the valid data to verify the research model. This research though analysis of page URL and user information to confirm crawl logic, then use the scrapy framework to write the crawler program to grab empirical panel count data. Compared with traditional questionnaire surveys, python crawlers can obtain larger samples and more objective data, which can describe the relationship between variables more truthfully and accurately. Thus, it further improves the accuracy of the results and the goodness fit of theoretical model. [Result/Conclusion] The research results show that the employees’ psychological needs and motivation (the personal integrative needs, hedonic needs and social integrative needs) have significant impacts on their continuous knowledge contribution behavior in Enterprise Social Media. The research conclusions enrich the theories of enterprise social media, knowledge management and user behavior, and has certain practical significance for enterprises to build and optimize social media platforms and guide employees to make positive and continuous knowledge contributions.

articleTitle: Research on the Revitalization of Real Economy based on digital technology
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Digital technology is a kind of science and technology which is concomitant with computer. Digital technology will make data become the core element, further optimize resource allocation, and drive the production efficiency of the real economy. Based on the perspective of digital industrialization and industry digitization, this paper puts forward that digitization is an important direction for the revitalization of real economy, and emphatically analyzes the internal mechanism of digital revitalization of real economy. This paper puts forward the idea of revitalizing the real economy and promoting the deep integration of the digital economy and the real economy, and holds that the digital revitalization of the real economy is an important way to enhance national competitiveness and build China into a great modern socialist country.

articleTitle: Incorporating Service Design for Industry 4.0: A Scientometric Review for Green and Digital Transformation Driven by Service Design
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Borne the potentials on optimizing organizational resources and service delivery process to improving the overall customer experience, service design has become an important means of digital transformation by promoting consumption upgrading and business model transformation. Along with digital technology, the main driver of industry 4.0, service design can be able to affect every aspect of the product life cycle, so that the production, delivery, consumption, and investment can be more sustainable. Therefore, how can we advance service design for system change bears great potential for addressing complex issues towards green and digital transformation. However, a comprehensive review of the intersections of related works of literature is missing. The purpose of this study is to provide a systematic review of the core literature and identify future research directions and challenges so that organizations can better utilize service design for green and digital transformation. Based on 549 articles retrieved from the Web of Science database, this research examined the main journals, emerging disciplines, and top author keywords, summarizing the major work surrounding the relationship between digital transformation and service design. The research found that researches on the intersection of service design and digital transformation have been undertaken mainly in three disciplines: industrial engineering, business and management science, environmental studies and green technology. Also, service design and Product-Service System can help organizations navigate the required transformation processes. The paper also suggests the need to further explore the intersection of service design and related research fronts of data-driven, SMEs, and future studies, with specific questions raised.

articleTitle: Application of Financial Information and Digital Transformation in Corporate Governance : A Scientometric Investigation
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Financial information provides direct information basis for corporate governance and can help enterprises operate efficiently. Furthermore, under the background of financial market going digital, financial information brings us more innovative than before. Not only government can have a macro-control of the economy through building a digital information system, but also enterprises can have a comprehensive handle of the governance in many details with financial information turning digital. As an important part of corporate governance, financial information affects the operation of corporate governance during its digital transformation. However, there is no complete literature review to explore the application of financial information in corporate governance from the perspective of digital transformation. By identifying and analyzing top key authors from 175 articles and their citations, which have been collected from the Web of Science database, this study can draw a network diagram composed of key fields and related research clusters. At the same time, combined with cross-disciplinary discussions, this article provides a reliable analysis of development trends for corporate governance to make better use of financial information in the digital age.

articleTitle: Game Analysis Of Information Collaboration in The Linkage Between Manufacturing Industry And Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The essence of the information collaboration process of the linkage between manufacturing industry and logistics industry is the process of the game between the node enterprises participating in the linkage. This paper constructs an information collaboration model of the linkage between manufacturing industry and logistics industry, and regards the linkage process of manufacturing industry and logistics industry as an information movement (transmission and sharing) process. On this basis, the game theory is used to build a game model of linkage information collaboration between manufacturing industry and logistics industry. The game model analyzes the impact of information sharing degree of manufacturing enterprises (M) and logistics enterprises (S) on the income function. The results show that there is a desire to cooperate with other members in the linkage between manufacturing and logistics. The greater information sharing degree between two-node enterprises, the greater the total income. On this basis, some suggestions are put forward to realize the efficient coordination and management of manufacturing and logistics industry.

Author Keywords: Linkage between manufacturing industry and logistics industry

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship Between Corporate Governance Performance and Financing Cost Under the Background of ESG Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, China's economy has developed rapidly, the market economy is booming, and the financing demand of enterprises is also increasing year by year. As a new development concept, environmental, social and corporate governance (ESG) theory has become an important evaluation index for the future development of enterprises. How to achieve sustainable development has become a necessary challenge for enterprise financing. Based on ESG theory and the empirical analysis, this paper can draw a conclusion that good corporate governance performance can effectively reduce the financing cost. According to this conclusion, this paper puts forward some suggestions on corporate governance based on ESG rating system.

articleTitle: Research on an Interpretable Real-Time Information Recommendation Model based on BAS-ICF algrithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Most of the existing studies on recommendation system are designed for the accuracy and novelty, but few are designed from the perspective of the user experience, which will cause users to feel confused about the recommendation results, especially in unfamiliar fields. So, this paper will introduce bias into the object-based collaborative filtering (ICF) algorithm. The bias can simultaneously quantify both the quality of the movie and the users' requirements, which not only helps to improve the accuracy of the recommendation, but also enhances the interpretability and real-time performance. It's shown graphically and experimentally. Even though the base-ICF algorithm is not as accurate as the deep-learning algorithm, it performs better in real-time and interpretability, which can achieve a good balance among these three factors.

articleTitle: Comparison between Autoregression model and Gaussian Process model on stock price prediction: a case study with the Microsoft stock
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Prediction of the stock price is an important topic in time-series analysis field. Two methods have been compared in this paper: Autoregression model (AR) and Gaussian Process (GP) with Microsoft stock price data to illustrate the performances of these two algorithms. From the empirical results, GP model outperforms the AR model in terms of both MSE and predictive accuracy, and it also provides the uncertainty quantification of the prediction, which makes it a clear winner under this case. However, the GP model also requires higher computational cost and is more sensitive to hyperparameters.

articleTitle: Research on relationship between FDI and Green Total Factor Productivity Based on Fixed Effects Model——China’s Manufacturing Data
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Foreign Direct Investment is the main driving force for the development of China's manufacturing industry, and total factor productivity is an important tool for analyzing economic growth. Therefore, studying the impact of FDI on China's manufacturing industry's total factor productivity plays a key role in China's economic development. However, existing research is rarely based on the concept of green development. Therefore, this paper selects the manufacturing panel data of 28 provinces in China from 2007 to 2018 as a sample to construct a regression model to study the impact of manufacturing FDI on manufacturing green total factor productivity. The results show that China's manufacturing FDI is not conducive to the improvement of China's manufacturing green total factor productivity. For every 10,000 RMB increase in manufacturing FDI, the manufacturing green total factor productivity drops by 0.0350 units.

articleTitle: Applying Service Design in Public Services: A Scientometric Review for Innovations in Public Health and Administration
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: As service design thinking in public services has increasingly attracted attention for producing innovative solutions to wicked problems, its application promises great potentials in creating better and more responsive services. However, there is no comprehensive review on the topic specifically on service design for the fields of public health and public administration. Based on the current discussions on the value of design for public health and public administration, the paper presents a systematic literature review into the specific discussions on service design, with the purpose to provide better public service innovations, especially in the context of recognizing the human needs in the technological digital advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Big Data, and Cloud Computing. The paper outlines the areas of applications, issues, and challenges for future research and policy innovations. By analyzing top keywords and authors from 529 articles, collected from the Web of Science database, the scientometric study reveals an emerging loose network of concepts and authors. Although the impact of such work remains limited at its early stage of development, the combination of both human-centered insights and system thinking processes at the organization levels, brought by the service design approach, has shown to tackle some of the wicked problems of public health and public administration. Future research and design workshops can be conducted to reinvigorate the notion of people-centered commitments for public service innovations, with societal relevance and scientific rigor.

articleTitle: Research on the Evolution Law of Human-computer Interaction Function in Computer Operating System and Control Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, computer operating systems and control methods are gradually optimized, of which the human-computer interaction function is prevalent and under highly-valued. Even though it facilitates people's lives, in the meantime it still has shortcomings and needs to be improved. This paper studies the development process and evolution law of the human-computer interaction function module in the computer's operating system and control method, and at the last part, its current deficiencies has been analyzed according to development status and social requirements also focused on the trend of human-computer interaction in the future. This study used comparison and contrast method to classify the different ways of human-computer interaction at each stage and its application results. Finally, it draws a conclusion about its evolution law: human-computer interaction goes from complex to simple, and then from single to compound.

articleTitle: Research on regulation method of electric vehicle and air conditioner participating in incentive demand response
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The scheduling of flexible load is an effective measure to alleviate the contradiction between supply and demand. It is of great significance to bring the flexible load into the normal operation scheduling of power system. The direct load control in incentive demand response is implemented for generalized energy storage loads such as electric vehicles (EVs) and air conditioners. The joint dispatching mode of electric vehicles and air conditioners is studied with the goal of maximizing the interests of the power grid and minimizing the electricity costs of users, and the dispatching mode is applied to the new energy system. The calculation example shows that the combined dispatching of EV and air conditioning load can realize complementary effect, reduce the dispatch cost by 13.5%, and make the distribution transformer not loaded while ensuring the interests of the power grid and users and have the ability of coordinated dispatching with PV.

articleTitle: Research on load optimal regulation of island system with renewable energy generation based on demand response
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Wind power generation, as one of the most promising development methods of renewable energy, has been widely valued. Affected by the fluctuation and indirectness of wind speed, the output of wind turbine has the characteristics of randomness and correlation, which will bring many uncertainties to the operation of island system. The uncertainty of new energy output will make it difficult to match supply and demand of island system. In this paper, Weibull probability distribution is used to simulate wind power, subsection function is used to describe the uncertainty of wind power, and an optimal load regulation model of island system based on demand response is established with the objective function of minimizing. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Analysis of IEEE Literature Statics and Dynamics based on probability theory and correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In recent years, the quantity of big scholarly data has a rapid growth, which brings new problems and challenges to the big scholarly data analysis. This paper employs the probability theory and correlation analysis methods to analyze the dynamics of publicly available research meta-data from IEEE official site. The experiment gives several visual evolution results of the correlations about journals and subjects, which provides some indications for future related research.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation in Macao Gaming Industry Based on the Model of Malmquist Index
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper aims to investigate the development of Macao's gaming industry during the past decades. This topic has tracked tons of attention while little works has been done to measure the Macao's gaming industry from performance perspective. Based on the theory of linear programming, the mathematical model of Malmquist index has been implied to measure the performance of gaming sectors. Data are collected from six Macao main casino concessionaires in the year of 2007-2014, the analysis result reveal that on the average, the efficiency of Macao's gaming industry is 82.3% and total factor productivity growth improved 17.4% for the period 2007-2014.

articleTitle: The implication of SARS virus on consumption: evidence from a prediction model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper provides empirical evidence regarding the implication of a public health event - the SARS outbreak. After the SARS epidemic broke out in 2003, the impact of the epidemic on consumption has become a hot topic. Combining previous theoretical research and practical conclusions, this article takes residential households as the research object and obtains micro-data through household surveys to study the impact of the SARS epidemic on residents' consumption. Micro-level evidence points to the conclusion that residents' willingness to consume has declined. I also show some factors that potentially drive the change in the consumption pattern.

articleTitle: CSR Disclosure and Stock Return Volatility in China: An Empirical Study Based on Panel Data Models
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Corporate social responsibility (CSR) considers the sustainable development of environment and economy simultaneously, yet its impact on the stock market is controversial among academics. This paper examines the influencing factors of stock price volatility from the perspective of CSR information disclosure. This study takes Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share listed companies from 2015 to 2019 as samples, and constructs panel data models to test the impact of CSR information disclosure on stock return volatility. The results show that CSR disclosure is negatively related with stock return volatility. It indicates that the disclosures of corporate social responsibility by corporations significantly reduce the risk of future stock volatility in the financial markets. After conducting robustness tests, the above conclusion still holds. This paper not only enriches the influencing factors of stock return volatility, but also provides new empirical support for the prevention of stock volatility risk.

articleTitle: Disruptive Innovation path Selection of Emerging Industries Based on Extension Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Disruptive innovation has become the most important strategies for the development of emerging industries, especially the path of disruptive innovation. This paper uses extension model, which can solve incompatible problems hierarchically and in stages. By establishing relevant indicators and experts scoring and using extension model analyse them to research the path selection, the technological breakthrough-new market development should be chosen. This finding provides reference for the practice of disruptive innovation of emerging industries.

articleTitle: Analysis of China’s Manufacturing Green Total Factor Productivity——Based on SBM Direction Distance Function and Malmquist-Luenberger Index Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Based on green development considerations, green total factor productivity is an important tool for analyzing green economic growth. Therefore, based on the consideration of energy input and carbon dioxide emissions, this paper uses SBM direction distance function combined with Malmquist-Luenberger productivity index method to calculate manufacturing green total factor productivity, and depose it into manufacturing green technological efficiency and manufacturing green technological progress. The results show that from 2007 to 2018, manufacturing green total factor productivity was 1.110, of which the manufacturing green technology progress was 1.106, and manufacturing green technology efficiency was -0.034. The development of manufacturing green technological progress can increase manufacturing green total factor productivity to a large extent.

articleTitle: Is bigger better? —— A DEA examination of the efficiencies of public tourism attractions in Sichuan Province, China
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is a mathematical tool commonly used for studying non-parametric frontier efficiency. It can be applied to examine the efficiencies in tourism industry. This article uses it to examines the technical efficiencies of 11 tourism attractions comprising six 4-A and five 5-A public tourism locations in Sichuan Province, China utilizing a Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) approach. Based on the results, it is found that for public tourism attraction, efficiency it is not necessarily a case of bigger being better. The article provides evidence to support the idea as well as gives several reasons to explain such conclusion.

articleTitle: Measurement of Economic Growth Contribution of Technological Progress in China’s First-tier Cities Based on Solow Residual Method
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This study uses the Solow Residual method which is a tool to measure the productivity growth other than capital investment and labor input, and this productivity growth which can represent technological progress in long-term to construct a panel regression model for the four China's first-tier cities in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen from 1992 to 2017 to measure the contribution rate of technological progress to economic growth, and conclude that the economic growth of first-tier cities mainly depends on technological progress.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Introduction of the Third Basic Method of Management Accounting from the Perspective of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, big data information technology has become an important and key field of modern information technology. The establishment of big data can help the continuous development of social productive forces and enhance the development power in various fields of society. In the field of management accounting, the wide application of big data technology is very necessary and can effectively improve the efficiency of management accounting. At present, the traditional basic methods of management accounting are only cost-benefit analysis and variable cost method, which will inevitably encounter unsolved problems in solving the specific problems of management accounting. Therefore, it is necessary to introduce a third basic method to solve practical problems in the field of management accounting.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Chengdu Real Estate Investment and Regional Economic Development Based on Cointegration Model and Vector Error Correction Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This article comprehensively applies unit roots, cointegration analysis, vector error correction model theory and other methods, based on the time-series data of Chengdu real estate development investment (REI) and gross regional product (GDP) 1990 to 2019, in-depth research and investigation Their mutual relationship. Construct a cointegration model to describe the long-term equilibrium relationship between variables, and construct an error correction model to reflect the short-term unbalanced relationship between variables. Empirical analysis shows a significant cointegration relationship between Chengdu's real estate investment and economic growth. The vector error correction model's establishment shows that Chengdu's real estate investment and economic growths are short-term fluctuations and long-term equilibrium.

articleTitle: Creadit Assessments of Cross-Border E-Commerce SMES in Guangdong based on Hierarchical Analysis and Fussy Sytem with Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the globalizing of economic development in recent years, cross-border e-commerce has gradually broken the traditional import and export model and shown great development potential. However, since the differences in policy, culture, regular, and social systems among different countries and areas exist, the stake of credit has become a challenge for the development of cross-border e-commerce. The big data produced by these institutions are becoming the focus of related research. By utilizing the data rationally, enterprises can skillfully avoid the risk and reach a better development. In this paper, a credit assessment indicator system to solve the credit challenges of cross-border e-commerce of small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in Guangdong was proposed. Furthermore, a rational credit stake assessment model was established by using the computational method of hierarchical analysis to determine the weight of various indicators. The validation of the proposed model was assessed by an evaluation method based on the fuzzy system in the computer field. The model provides a firm ground for cross-border e-commerce enterprises to make policies to reduce or even avoid loss when facing credit risk. This cross-field research combing the computational models with the business behaviors contributes to the healthy and sustainable developments for cross-border e-commerce SMEs in Guangdong.

articleTitle: Uses Logistic Regression Analysis to Explore Between the Financial Crises and Financial Statement Restatements Relationship Under the Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Exploring the results of restating corporate financial statements will illustrate the importance and urgency of corporate digital transformation. This research focuses on the general industrial companies listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange from 2010 to 2019, with collecting data including corporate governance, financial ratios, and restated financial statements, and uses logistic regression analysis to explore between the financial crises and restatements relationship. In the past ten years, there have been 258 companies that have reorganized their financial statements, and 306 companies have experienced any crisis in the financial crisis. According to the influential variable X left by the two analysis methods, there are a total of 21 main variables and 7 secondary variables. After the analysis, there are two results. First, there is a significant correlation between the restatement of financial statements and the occurrence of a financial crisis. Second, when the financial statements are restated, the probability of a financial crisis will increase. This result shows that the digital transformation of finance will effectively reduce the probability of enterprises re-compiling statements and improve corporate governance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regional Logistics in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Based on Grey Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Regional logistics as a leading force in the development of regional economic systems became more and more important. This article, applying the gray relational cluster analysis method to analyze the relevant economic and logistics indicators of 11 cities in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, analyzes the factors that have a greater impact on logistics and puts forward certain guiding suggestions for improvement in response to these factors. It is conducive to the healthy development of the logistics industry in the Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area..(Abstract).

articleTitle: Grey Relational Analysis of Regional Logistics Concentration and Regional Economic Development in the Pearl River Delta
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The regional logistics industry is of great significance to promote the development of industrial structure. This paper measures the regional agglomeration, enterprise agglomeration and regional agglomeration structure of the logistics industry in the Pearl River Delta from 2013 to 2019, and uses the gray correlation model to analyze the relationship between transportation, storage and postal industry, wholesale and retail industry and economic development. The study found that the logistics industry in the Pearl River Delta at this stage has not formed a reasonable agglomeration structure, whether it is transportation, storage and postal industry, or wholesale and retail. The agglomeration and structure of the transportation, storage, and postal industries in the Pearl River Delta are better than those of wholesale and retail, but the agglomeration of wholesale and retail has a greater impact on economic development. Full attention should be paid to the promotion of regional economic development by the agglomeration of the logistics industry, the positive externalities of the agglomeration of the logistics industry should be brought into play, the supply-side reform of the logistics industry should be actively promoted, and differentiated guidance strategies should be adopted for the transportation, warehousing and postal industries, and wholesale and retail industries.

articleTitle: Analysis of Rural Women’s Non-agricultural Work Based on the Application of Computer Models: taking Oprobit and the Mediation Effect Model as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The application of computer models has become an important means and tool for writing papers today. Based on the 2012, 2013, and 2015 data of the China Comprehensive Social Survey, the article first uses the Oprobit model to find that engaging in non-agricultural work significantly reduces the subjective well-being of rural women. Once again, the OLS estimation and Ologit model are used to verify the robustness of the results; second, non-agricultural work has a more obvious impact on junior high school, high school education, and the economic status of the family at an average level or below, and the individual's happiness in 2013 and 2015, however, the inhibitory effect of the high school group is greater than that of the junior high school group, and the average family economic status suppression effect is greater than the average level, and it is greater than 2013 in 2015; and finally, it was found that social entertainment played a part of the mediating effect of 11.03%, the mechanism of this effect is: rural women engaged in non-agricultural work reduce the frequency of leisure time entertainment and social interaction, thereby inhibiting the happiness effect.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of Richards model based on improved drosophila algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Aiming at the practical problem of complex parameter estimation in Richards model, the parameter estimation problem of Richards model is transformed into a multi-dimensional nonlinear function optimization problem by following the principle of "least squares". Combined with the deformation monitoring data of foundation pit slope in a certain construction project and through C++ programming, variable random search step size strategy and variable drosophila population size strategy were introduced to realize the adaptive improvement of standard drosophila algorithm (FOA), so as to improve the local search ability and search efficiency of the algorithm. In order to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the algorithm's estimation parameters, the improved Fruit fly algorithm (IFOA), particle swarm optimization (PSO) and genetic Algorithm (GA) are compared and analyzed. The results show that the improved Fruit fly algorithm (IFOA) is more applicable to the parameter estimation of Richards model.

articleTitle: Research on the development path of Rural Micro tourism in Yangzhou based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the upgrading of tourism consumption demand, the diversification of tourism product supply and the gradual introduction of the 2.5-day vacation system, the micro short vacation tourism mode has begun to enter people's vision. It is a new form of tourism and a deep excavation of urban tourism resources. Taking the network information as the sample data, using data collection and data mining technology, namely based on network data mining method and questionnaire survey method to obtain Yangzhou rural tourism data. Based on the data, this paper analyzes the positive impact of rural tourism development on Yangzhou's social economy, culture and environment, discusses the concept of rural tourism and its causes, analyzes the demand and development of rural tourism in Yangzhou, and puts forward four paths of Rural Micro tourism in Yangzhou, namely, innovating core intellectual property rights, creating theme B & B, improving five sense products, and shaping brand new enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Financing Difficulties of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises in Anhui Province under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Under the background of Big Data, small and medium-sized enterprises in Anhui Province still face many problems. The outstanding problem is financing. Based on qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis, this paper studies the current situation of small and medium-sized enterprises in Anhui Province and the financing difficulties of small and medium-sized enterprises under the background of Big Data, this paper puts forward some countermeasures to solve the financing problems of small and medium-sized enterprises in Anhui province under the background of Big Data: strengthening the financing consciousness and self-management system construction of small and medium-sized enterprises; We will improve the financial financing system for small and medium-sized enterprises, create new channels for their financing, strengthen the construction of the concept of credit guarantee and upgrade their credit rating, and make full use of state policies.

articleTitle: Vertical channel structure strategy in competing supply chains under third party’s extended warranties based on inverse demand function
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper established two competing supply chains consisting of two manufacturers and two exclusive retailers, in which two retailers sell substitutable products and also sell extended warranties for the products they sell. We use inverse demand function to describe the product price. It is an interdisciplinary application in the field of mathematics and management. From the perspective that both chain members can be better off, this paper studies how the market competition and third party's extended warranty policy impact the dominance of the vertical channel structure strategy of two symmetrical supply chains which propose the same channel structures. The results show that when the market competition is mild, or when the market competition intensity is moderate and the product initial market size is lower than specific threshold value, pure coordinated channel structure (in which both chains propose coordinated structure) is superior to pure decentralized channel structure (in which both chains propose decentralized structure). When the competition intensity is moderate and the product initial market size is higher than the specific threshold, or when the competition is extremely intensive, pure decentralized channel structure is superior to pure coordinated channel structure. And no matter whether the supply chains choose pure coordination or pure decentralized, there are different fixed areas composed of market competition intensity and initial market size, so that supply chains and third parties can make more profits at the same time.

articleTitle: Overconfidence and anomalies in Chinese stock markets: a literature review
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: There are numerous anomalies in the financial markets, which is difficult to be explained by the traditional efficient market theory. Overconfidence theory, motivated by the psychological evidence, increasingly becomes popular for better understanding the stock markets. This study aims to comprehensively and thoroughly review the relevant literature which looks at the economic consequences of investor overconfidence, and analyze how the overconfidence theory consequently raises some financial markets anomalies.

articleTitle: Industrial structure factor analysis of complex network basis
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the knowledge assistance of complex network and 10 years of input-output table, this essay dynamically analyzes the current situation of China's industrial structure and concluded that the industrial sectors in China are closely related under the unique national conditions. The weighted clustering coefficient is concentrated in 0.1308~0.2584, while the non-weighted clustering coefficient is concentrated in 0.644~0.7811. The weighted agglomeration coefficient is smaller than the unweighted agglomeration coefficient, which indicates that the network composed of China's national economic structure is relatively uniform and there is no dominant country, which also indicates that the tertiary industry of China is not strong enough. Meanwhile, the average distance and nearest neighbor distribution of the network also indicate that most industries are closely connected and inseparable from each other. As further deepening the adjustment of industrial structure, we should take fully consideration of this point. The main contribution of this essay is to introduce the agglomeration coefficient, with the usage of input-output direct coefficient to construct the industrial network, achieve the rules of industrial connection, and then make theoretical preparation for the next step of deepening the adjustment of industrial structure.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Impacts of Assets and Financial Assets of Families on Their Expenditure and Consumption---Based on CFPS Database
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's economy, the income and expenditure of Chinese households became more diversified. Many families had assets and investments. The wealth effects of these assets played an increasingly obvious role in driving consumption growth. This paper used the data of the National Bureau of Statistics and the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) collected by Peking University from 2010 to 2019 to study the impacts of values of family's total assets and financial assets on the total expenditure and consumption expenditure of Chinese households. We constructed two Panel Models, and used Stata 12 software to run the Regression tests. The results of panel regressions reveal that the family's total assets and financial assets have positive impacts on both total expenditure and consumption expenditure of families. These mean that the wealth effects of the total assets and financial assets are obvious.

articleTitle: Case Study on Order Picking Route Optimization in Distribution Centers Based on GA
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the shortest picking distance as the objective, this paper studied on the optimization of the order picking route in distribution centers. We applied the genetic algorithm to simulate the process of GASM and in two different route ship--Mid-point and S-ship.
