At last, we provided four numerical examples for each algorithm and with all other hypotheses remaining the same. Through this study, we illustrated the distance variety of order picking when the S- shaped picking route was changed to the central- point picking route.

articleTitle: Financial Analysis and Countermeasure Research of New Energy Automobile Industry : ———Take Weilai Automobile Co., Ltd. as an example
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Since 2001, with the continuous improvement of China's economic development and technological level, the scarcity of energy and the increasingly severe environmental problems, the government has begun to attach great importance to the development of new energy vehicles. The strategy of "energy-saving and new energy vehicles" in China's "Eleventh Five-Year Plan" includes the new energy vehicle industry in the category of strategic emerging industries, creating advantages for the rise and development of new energy vehicles. This article takes Weilai Automobile Co., Ltd. as an example, combines its financial data in recent years, analyzes its financial status from the perspective of financial statements and indicator analysis, and proposes corresponding countermeasures for the development of its new energy automobile industry.

articleTitle: Regression Model Analysis of Tax Preferential Policies for Promoting High-tech Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: At present, with the rapid reform of economic globalization and technological innovation, every country takes technological innovation and high-tech development as the top priority. In particular, China's current development mode has changed dramatically, from relying on factors and investment in the past to now entering the Industry 4.0 era, only the enterprise continuously carries on the research and the development activity, can maintain the good competitive advantage and the sustainable development. Therefore, we should have a deep understanding of the current situation and problems of the development of high-tech enterprises, and then understand the current trend of tax preferential policies, and formulate more reasonable and meaningful tax preferential policies, to further promote the healthy development of high-tech enterprises. In addition, this paper used regression model analysis shows that the preferential tax policy to the enterprise incentive effect, is an interdisciplinary research in the field of mathematics.

articleTitle: The impact of female and independent directorships on the quality of financial reporting
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This study aims to examine whether female directors and independent directors have an impact on financial reporting quality in the Chinese market. A sample of 545 listed enterprises over five years (2013-2017) is analyzed using the logistic regression method. Results show that there is a significant positive relationship between the presence of female directors and financial reporting quality. Independent directors also have a positive influence on financial reporting quality.

articleTitle: Construction of quality management system based on blockchain and its evaluation system based on AHP-BP
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper uses the mathematical technique AHP-BP and applicates the blockchain technology. First, it constructs a comprehensive quality management system conclusing everyone from raw material suppliers to consumers base on the advantages and characteristics of blockchain technology in view of the difficult problems in quality management. Then in order to test the effect of the system, it constructs the evaluation system of quality management system, it uses AHP-BP method to give the weight of evaluation indicators scientifically. Through scoring, it proves that the quality management system proposed has obvious advantages in this paper.

articleTitle: Regulation of App users’ privacy security based on three-party evolutionary game model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Evolutionary game is a method to explain the strategy-choices of decision-makers through calculating the replication dynamic equations. In the study, three-party evolutionary game and prospect theory are used to analyze the dynamics strategy changes of the government, the App store, and the App software under the government privacy regulation. MATLAB is used to do the simulation analysis. According to the results, the best evolutionary stability point will be changed when considering prospect theory. The sensitivity of government's perceived value and loss avoidance are the key impact factors. The conclusions provide suggestions for further exploration of privacy regulation.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Volvo in China: Using the non market strategy to analyze the underperforming of high reputation companies
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In today's information age, corporate reputation and performance has increasingly become the focus of attention. This study attempts to answer the question that we noticed in this area -why reputable companies are underperforming? - from the perspective of non-market strategy. The (IA)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> framework, short for issue-actors-interests-arena-information-assets, is selected to analyze the non-market environment, and the answer is given according to the results of the analysis. In general, the study finds that three non-market factors, namely politics, media and consumer psychology, are the important reasons for the poor performance of companies with good reputation. We believe that this is a meaningful research because it explains a counter intuitive phenomenon in the field of economic management from the perspective of non-market strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the Standardization and Flexible Management of University Educational Affairs
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: China's higher education is currently in the period of mass education. The workload of educational administration management in institutions of higher learning keeps expanding, and the complexity and difficulty of management has been increasing. Meanwhile, the higher education in the popularization stage should not only rely on the increase of "quantity" of students, but also the improvement of "quality" of talent training. The core center of the educational administration system is also inevitably shifted from the university-level educational administration department to the faculty. Therefore, it is necessary for us to re-comprehend the standardized management of educational affairs in institutions of higher learning. According to the algorithm, the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) establishes a hierarchical structure model, which is divided into the highest layer, the middle layer and the lowest layer to construct a judgment matrix to compare all factors and finally obtain the ranking weights. This paper uses analytic hierarchy process and interview method to understand the connotation of factors weight of various educational affairs management activities, and finally puts forward the strategy of standardized and flexible management of educational affairs. According to this strategy, various work procedures and guidelines are compiled, especially the use of information management means, and specific guidance is provided to realize standardized and flexible management of educational affairs.

articleTitle: Data-analysis-based discussion on COVID-19 Pandemic Shocks to the Economy and Policy Responses : Cases in the United Kingdom
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This article analyzes the macroeconomic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the UK and the government's response measures by comparing original data and building regression models with STATA. The British economy was stable before the pandemic. However, the outbreak of COVID-19 has plunged the British economy into a massive recession. The British government and the Bank of England have formulated a series of measures to address the negative impact of the pandemic on the economy. The empirical results for one of the monetary policies show that the Bank of England policy has a significant effect on stimulating financial markets and preventing economic recession.

articleTitle: Prediction and analysis of population aging based on computer Leslie model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the continuous development of society, the change of population age structure is more and more important to the regional economy. The computer Leslie model can use the age distribution of the population at a certain time to dynamically predict the age distribution of the population and the evolution of population number with time. Therefore, based on the panel data of population in Hubei Province from 2010 to 2019, the Leslie model is used to simulate and predict the change trend of population and age structure in Hubei Province. The results show that the total population growth of Hubei Province is relatively slow, but the aging degree is gradually deepening. Based on the influence of aging on economic growth, this paper puts forward some policy suggestions for the development of Hubei Province and the central region.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Sustainability of Community Bank——Evidence from Guilin Bank Nanning Branch
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Booming Internet finance and interest rate market make the banks pay more attention to the issue of sustainable development. This study analyzes the factors that affect the sustainable development of banks by collecting 11 indicators, including deposit-loan ratio, non-performing loan ratio, capital adequacy ratio, asset profit margin, deposit growth rate, liquidity ratio, loan growth rate, operating income, operating profit, deposit amount and loan amount. Establish linear regression model to analyze the factors that affect the bank’s sustainable development.According to the comprehensive evaluation value of sustainable development is obtained,the score of sustainable development is increasing according to the year and community banking benefits increase. It shows that the existing business model of Community Bank built by Guilin Bank is sustainable and has an impact on its future development.

articleTitle: Research on Real Carbon Emission Performance of Financial Industry Based on DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In order to explore the real carbon emission performance of the financial industry, this paper constructs a performance evaluation index system from the perspective of input and output, and uses the DEA model to carry out the real carbon emission performance of the financial industry. Finally, the paper makes a comparative analysis of the model results. The results show that the real carbon emissions of the financial industry are generally effective.

articleTitle: The Effects of Executive Compensation Incentive on Implicit Corruption in China Based on Multiple Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This study investigates whether and how executive compensation incentives improve the governance of corporate implicit corruption based on multiple linear regression model. In addition to compensation level/amount adopted in related researches under Chinese context, executive compensation incentives involve the incentive intensity measured by sensitivity between compensation and performance. It is found that executive compensation incentives have significant impacts on power-induced implicit corruption. Specifically, increasing the performance-based compensation incentive intensity may curb power-induced implicit corruption. However, merely raising the compensation is effective only when executives are in low-pay level. Our study provides an important internal governance perspective for implicit corruption based on the executive compensation incentive mechanism.

articleTitle: Measurement of Producer Services Agglomeration Level and Influence Factor Analysis : —Based on Panel Data of Provinces along the Belt & Road
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper is an interdisciplinary research article related to mathematics, and uses panel data of 16 provinces along the belt and road in 2012-2018 as the research object. First , it uses the mathematical formula of the location quotient to calculate the location index of the productive service industry in the provinces along the belt and road, so as to obtain the agglomeration level of the productive service industry in the provinces along the belt and road. Then, the index system of the influencing factors of producer services agglomeration is constructed, and the partial least squares structural equation model is used to explore the mechanism and degree of the influencing factors. The empirical research shows that urbanization rate, government intervention, public service investment, manufacturing development and financial industry development have positive and significant impact on the agglomeration of producer services, while Internet construction will indirectly affect the agglomeration of producer services through the development of manufacturing industry and financial industry.

articleTitle: Competitive Strength of P2P Platforms Based on Function and User Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Airbnb has developed in China for about 3 years, and attract many people to enjoy its cheap and personalized service. However, it faces lots of challenges including credit crisis, quality problems and competition from some similar products such as Tujia and Xiaozhu. With the method of collecting users' data and feedbacks, as well as analyzing Airbnb's business models and core functions, this passage aims to make a conclusion of Airbnb's strengths, weakness, opportunists and threats after COVID-19, and discuss the future risks that brought by the development of transient vacation rental industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Change Rule of the Proportion of the Added Value of Circulation Industry in GDP -- Based on nonlinear regression model and logarithmic model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Nonlinear regression model means that the relationship between variables is not linear, but it can be transformed into linear regression model through variable replacement; logarithmic model means that both sides of the equation take logarithm, which is conducive to reducing the heteroscedasticity of data in the model. Based on this model, this paper empirically analyzes the change law of the proportion of added value of circulation industry in GDP. The results of the study show that the change trend of the proportion of circulation industry added value to GDP does not present a single linear relationship, but a "inverted U-shaped" development law. In recent years, the market demand for circulation has been increasing, and the status and value of the circulation industry in the economic development are expending. The traditional circulation industry needs to be transformed and upgraded. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the development law of the added value of circulation industry in GDP for the construction of modern circulation system in China.

articleTitle: Research on Online Knowledge Payment Marketing Model from the Perspective of Media Economics
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the rapid development of media economy, knowledge payment marketing strategy plays an increasingly important role in all areas of life. From the perspective of media economy, it is particularly important for the survival and development of future enterprises to analyze the online knowledge paid marketing mode and improve the online knowledge paid marketing skills. Knowledge payment is a form of sharing and communication, which refers to a process in which knowledge disseminators transfer different skills and intellectual resources on a public or specific platform through network payment. From the perspective of media economics, the future pay for knowledge marketing model should focus on strengthening knowledge service, establishing and improving user response mechanism, coordinating offline resources, strengthening Internet interactive operation of knowledge community and ultimately optimizing the source of paid knowledge. This paper makes a detailed analysis and Research on the common modes of knowledge payment, hoping to bring new inspiration and new ideas to the marketing mode of the company.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Material Suppliers Based on BP Neural Network under The Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Nowdays for construction enterprises, there are more material suppliers to choose under the background of big data application in construction industry. Therefore how to evaluate and select the material suppliers correctly and wisely become a particularly important work for manager to control the cost and quality of a project. Firstly, the material supplier evaluation index system is constructed, then the method of obtaining relevant data is put forward. Based on the above, the material supplier evaluation model is constructed by using the BP neural network algorithm. Finally, the applicability and reliability of this model are demonstrated through an example, which provides reference for the evaluation of material suppliers in the practice of building materials procurement.

articleTitle: An Economics Analysis of the EU ETS Emission Trading System
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper provides a comprehensive economic analysis of the benefits, costs and complementary policies of the EU ETS emission trading system and study the effects of the emission trading system on emission reduction in 2007-2017. The paper discusses the advantages of the emission trading system by solving the environmental externality and emission leakage problem. The paper collects and analyzes data from the European Pollutant Release and Transfer Register (E-PRTR), and finds that implementing EU ETS system reduces emissions of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O, CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, HFCs, PFCs, and SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>. The paper ends by discussing the implications for building a global emission trading system.

articleTitle: The Impact of Business Environment on China’s Import and Export Trade with the Countries along the Belt and the Road—An Empirical Analysis based on the Extended Gravity Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In this paper, connections of fixed effects and the extended gravity model with mathematics are built, for the purpose of mathematics-related interdisciplinary application. Based on the relevant data of the import and export trade between China and the countries along the Belt and Road and the global business environment data released by the world bank, the influence of the business environment on the import and export trade between China and other countries along the Belt and the Road is examined through the fixed gravity effect with the expanded gravity model. The results show that: (1) the business environment optimization of the countries along the Belt and Road can significantly promote bilateral import and export trade; (2) China's business environment optimization can also promote bilateral import and export trade, but not significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Internal Control of Financial Accounting Information System Based on ERP System
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the development of the economy and the advent of the era of big data, traditional manual accounting has also been replaced by accounting information technology. The ERP system is actually a network operation platform. It is a comprehensive information system based on the premise of computer network technology that integrates the business activities of the enterprise such as purchasing, production, and sales. The ERP system adopted by most companies has greatly improved the efficiency of corporate financial management, but the application of ERP system brings fast and convenient. At the same time, it also puts forward higher requirements for the internal control of the enterprise. This paper studies the internal control and risk management of the financial accounting information system under the ERP environment, and proposes countermeasures.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Block-chain in Internet of Vehicles Insurance
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: On the basis of the connotation and characteristics of block-chain, combined with the reality and opportunities of Internet of vehicles insurance, this paper explores the application of block-chain technology in the scientific and reasonable pricing, accurate service, prevention of fraud insurance, and provides customers with more reasonable value-added service of Internet of vehicles insurance, so as to accelerate the development of Internet of vehicles insurance.

articleTitle: The Impact of Aging on Economic Growth Based on Health Investment and Technological Innovation: An Empirical Study from China
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Will aging definitely depress economic growth? Based on the panel data of 31 provinces in China from 2007 to 2017, this paper proposes research hypotheses from the perspective of health investment and technology innovation and then conducts an empirical test of fixed effects panel model based on the Cobb-Douglas production function to prove the relationship between aging and economic growth. Consistent with the mainstream literature, this paper finds that aging does have a significant negative impact on economic growth, that is, for every 1% of population aging, economic growth will decrease 0.089%, but the interaction between aging and health investment or aging and technological innovation on economic growth is significantly positive, namely 0.061%, 0.087% respectively. This means that aging can notably promote economic growth through the paths of health investment and technological innovation. Obviously, The final effect of aging on economic growth depends on the combination of negative effect and positive effect. The findings of this research suggest giving full play to the economic effects of health investment and technological innovation, so as to realize the balanced development of healthy aging, innovation leading, and economic growth.

articleTitle: Restaurant Reviews Analysis Model Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In recent years, the emergence of a variety of social media has dramatically enriched people's lives and generated a massive amount of data, which has provided great opportunities and challenges for the application of building a data-driven machine learning analysis model. Due to its high commercial value, customer review data are continuously collected and analyzed by various merchants or networks. Through the analysis of consumers' dining experience and the evaluation of the restaurant's food and service, the restaurant can continuously adjust its business strategy, which is of high economic value to the restaurant. As for consumers, they can avoid unpleasant dining experience and have a better experience of local specialty food by looking at people's reviews. The analysis model based on machine learning algorithms and big data can efficiently and accurately extract the critical letters in customer reviews, predict customer behavior, and proofread the accuracy of reviews to achieve a win-win situation for restaurants and consumers, to strive for the maximum economic benefits.

articleTitle: Research on the development level of regional science and technology service industry
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Under the background of innovation-driven development strategy, evaluating the development level of regional science and technology service industry (RSTSI) is an effective means to promote the efficient utilization of resources and guide the innovation and sustainable development of regional industries. Based on identifying the influencing factors of the development level of RSTSI, this paper first constructs the evaluation index system of the development level of RSTSI from the four dimensions, namely, industrial innovation service environment, industrial service resource base, industrial innovation service level and industrial innovation development potential, and then introduces the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation (FCE) to develop the evaluation method. The AHP can help achieve a reasonable index weighting on the basis of integrating the empirical judgments of experts in relevant fields, while the FCE can help evaluate the target affected by multiple factors and combine the advantages of both qualitative and quantitative evaluation. Finally, the RSTSI in Heilongjiang Province is selected as an empirical case, and the development level is "average". The empirical results show that the evaluation index system and method developed in this paper can effectively evaluate the development level of RSTSI, so its application can provide guidance for industrial sustainable development planning and government policy design.

Author Keywords: regional science and technology service industry

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact on Urban Innovation under the upsurge of Digital inclusive Finance based on A. Empirical model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the vigorous development of China's digital economy and the deepening of financial inclusion, the impact of digital inclusive finance on urban innovation efficiency will be more prominent. This paper studies the influence and internal mechanism of digital inclusive finance on urban innovation by establishing an empirical model. An empirical test is conducted based on the panel data of 283 cities at prefecture level and above from 2013 to 2018. The results show that: first, compared with traditional finance, digital inclusive finance has a more significant impact on the improvement of urban innovation efficiency, and the results are still valid after a series of robustness tests and endogenous treatment. second, the building of urban core industrial advantages is an important channel for digital inclusive finance to affect the improvement of urban innovation efficiency. Third, the above effects have a certain degree of temporal and spatial heterogeneity, especially in 2016, especially in coastal cities, near port cities and big cities.

articleTitle: Analysis of Application of Fama-French 3-factor Model and Fama-French 5-factor Model in Manufacture Industry and Health Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Fama French three-factor and Fama French five-factor models are important models for explaining stock returns and finding risk factors. This study mainly includes the analysis of the coefficients of the two models to evaluate which model has a higher explanatory power and determine the influence factors for the manufacturing industry and health industry through comparison. The linear regression method is adopted to calculate the coefficients for the Fama French three factors and five factors, thereby exploring the risk factors and development potential of the two industries. Based on the comparison of the results of the coefficients of the two industries, the results indicate that 1) the manufacturing industry is more sensitive than the health industry to the fluctuations of the market economy; 2) the overall market of the health industry tends to favor large-scale enterprises while the manufacturing industry favors small-scale enterprises; and 3) the health industry has a lower book-to-market ratio, but enjoys a better development prospect than the manufacturing industry. Therefore, through the results of the analysis of the three factors and the performance of the overall market, it is concluded that the health industry is more favorable for investment at the present stage of economic and technological level.

articleTitle: Analysis on the influence of urban living environment on healthy human capital based on health production function
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Based on urban living environment on the health of human capital as the research core, the new healthy production function was constructed by integrating the urban environment pollution, urban infrastructure, city appearance cleaning and other 11 factors that have influence on the human capital of health into the healthy production function proposed by Grossman. In addition, the provincial panel data from 2008 to 2017 in China were used to conduct regression analysis on the specific impact by using the fixed-effect model. The estimated results show that :(1) urban environmental pollution will cause serious harm to the health of urban residents. For every 1% increase in sulfur dioxide emissions, the health human capital will decrease by 0.0228%;(2) medical resources and the education level of the population are bottlenecks affecting human capital of health, and insufficient resources will have a negative impact on human capital of health; (3)strengthening the construction of urban infrastructure, harmless treatment of garbage, investment in urban pollution control, urban public green space area and construction of cultural venues can help reduce the harm of urban gas, solid and water pollution, reduce the breeding of viruses and bacteria, and make cities more livable;(4)scientific and technological innovation depends not only on the number of authorized patents, but also on the quality and efficiency of the transformation of patents into scientific and technological achievements.

articleTitle: The Impact of Natural Disasters on Consumption Habits of Senior Population in China Based on DID Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Natural disasters impose significant economic impacts. Preceding work showed that natural disasters induced enormous negative shocks to consumption at the micro level. The research made use of the data of China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Studies (CHARLS), a nationally representative survey on the elderly to study how natural disasters influence household expenditure.Through multivariate regression analysis with Stata software, it's found that natural disasters have a statistically significant negative impact on household expenditure in the long run using disaster data dating back to 1945. The paper further used various mathematical models including probit model and Tobit model in additional to the OLS estimation to check the robustness of the results. From there, the focus shifts towards the impact of disaster on expenditure in the short run. Based on the computational results derived from the DID model with additional disaster data from Chinese Statistical Yearbook, the research was able to conclude that unlike the long-run effect, disasters have a significant positive effect in the short run.

articleTitle: Optimizing HVAC Systems in Buildings with Machine Learning Prediction Models: an Algorithm Based Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems have been widely employed in office buildings in China. However, these 24-hour running machines can result in plenty of unnecessary costs due to abundancies of cooling power created by extra power used. To cope with this scenario and maximize HVAC's running efficiency, this study builds prediction models with machine learning (ML) algorithms (including Gradient Boosting, Adaboost, and Random Forest) to optimize the existing systems with data derived from an office building in China. The goal of optimization is to attain the same of amount of cooling while less power is consumed, which is done by controlling the temperature setpoints to a more reasonable setting. With trained models, the results of optimization suggest a promising outcome that, for a single office building, at least 30156.40 could be saved annually, yielded by economic tools like Net Present Value (NPV), Life Cycle Cost Analysis (LCCA), and Social Carbon Cost (SCC). Findings in this paper could be generalized to other instances in the field of energy: power distribution grid, home appliances, irrigation systems etc. Apart from suggesting an optimization methodology for HVAC systems, this paper also aims to inspire more future work in energy conservation with more advanced technologies like machine learning, in the hope that the volatile, deteriorating global climate could be mitigated by cleaner and greener approaches in everyday life.

articleTitle: Study on the Timing Sequence of High Quality Development of Regional Economy Based on Boom State : —Taking Beijing, Shanghai and Guangdong as Examples
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Based on the basic connotation of high-quality economic development, the evaluation system of economic development state is established from five aspects to analyze the quality of economic development more comprehensively. The synthetic index method is used to calculate the leading and consistent index and analyze the boom index of high-quality economic development, and the empirical research method is used to discuss the temporal characteristics of economic development in different regions. The research results show that the evaluation system and the boom index can better reflect the state of economic development. The high-quality economic development of the three regions as a whole show cyclical fluctuation development and the fluctuation has slowed down in recent years. The fluctuation cycle is about 3.5 years and the fluctuation frequency is relatively short. Since 2012, the economic development momentum of Guangdong province has been stronger and its structure has been optimized, especially in infrastructure construction, financial investment and the development of tertiary industry. This has radiated the economic development of the surrounding areas and promoted the implementation of the policy of economic development transformation.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis on Influencing Factors of Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The rapid development of digital economy is bringing new driving force to the world economy. If China wants to seize the opportunity and catch the express train of digital economy, it must make clear about its influencing factors. Therefore, according to the data of China Statistical Yearbook from 2000 to 2019, this thesis makes a quantitative empirical analysis on the influencing factors of China's digital economy based on factor analysis, regression analysis and other research methods. The result of factor analysis shows: gross domestic product (GDP)(0.998), consumption level of all residents (HCL)(0.999), total investment in fixed assets of the whole society (CFAI)(0.969), elderly dependency ratio (OADR)(0.991), money supply (M2)(0.998), R&D expenditure(R&D)(0.999), and education appropriations (EA)(0.997) account for a great amount of contribution rate in component one, which means that these variables are the main influencing factors of digital economy, and have obvious positive effects on digital economy (The values in brackets are the component coefficients of corresponding variables). Urban registered unemployment rate (URUR)(0.779) and consumer price index (CPI)(0.752) account for a little big contribution rate in component 2, indicating that these two variables also positively promote the level of digital economy to a certain extent. The regression analysis results show that the sig values of constant, component one and component two variables are 0.00, 0.00 and 0.01 in turn, which has passed the significance test, indicating that the regression equation is meaningful. In other words, the development level of China's digital economy significantly depends on four main influencing factors, national economic strength, human capital, residents' income level and government intervention. In the end, according to the driving factors of digital economy, the thesis puts forward relevant policy suggestions to promote the development of China's digital economy.

articleTitle: Study of The Health Impact of Cooking Fuel Choice based on Logit and probit model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Dozens of previous literatures consider the health impact of solid fuel emissions from different perspectives. They focus on different groups of people based on different databases. We, in contrast, discuss the health outcome including self-rated health status, incidence rates of related diseases, ADL, IADL, and overweight according to certain standards through multiple regression models including OLS, logit and order probit, we found a statistically significant health impact. Demographic variable controls such as education level, age, marital status, and region where respondents live, as well as behavioral indicator such as smoking and drinking are included to reduce the model error. We, specifically, found that households with solid (i.e. dirty) fuels are particularly susceptible to poor self-rated health status, lower life satisfaction, higher incidence rate of chronic-lung diseases, heart-problems, hypertension and lower cognitive function, higher chance to be overweight and increased rigors to deal with daily activities. Dyslipidemia was not found to be correlated with solid cooking fuels. Gender and age basis was discussed. Women are found to benefit more from the use of non-solid (i.e. clean) cooking fuel, possibly because of their major responsibility for cooking in traditional Chinese household. Overall, our research sheds light on the health impact of indoor air pollution induced by cooking fuel emissions, particularly for those elderly people and orients the direction of further research.

articleTitle: Scientific and Technological Innovation Capability Improvement: A Case Study of the Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: In the context of a new round of scientific revolutions, the complicated and austere international political environment, and the domestic economy under a difficult transformation have brought unprecedented challenges to China. The government, industries and enterprises have reached a consensus on the issue: "continuous promotion of innovation is the only way to break through". However, the practice of innovation has brought far more challenges than expected. In technological innovation, for example, the existing issues and bottlenecks are directly impacting the national scientific and technological output and transformation of achievements. This paper, based on the author's understanding of and thoughts about an enterprise's R&D, analyses innovative connotations in a new era, scientific and technological innovation concept development and analysis, and the status quo, and analyses the reasons for scientific and technological innovation development. Using cases in the Chinese automotive industry, this paper provides advice on promoting the sustainable development of scientific and technological innovation capability.

articleTitle: Who Is Briliant? The Financial Competitiveness of Listed Companies from Rustbelt and Sunbelt in China
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Based on the financial data in 2018, of 43 listed companies in Liaoning Province and 49 relevant listed companioes in Jiangsu Province, the paper applies SPSS software to construct a financial competitiveness index system including 14 financial indicators, and uses factor analysis to analyze the four ability dimensions of profitability, operational capacity, solvence and development ability, to evaluate the financial competitiveness of the selected companies in two Provinces. The results show that the general financial competitiveness of listed companies in Liaoning Province is lower and the measures to improve the financial competitiveness are given for the listed companies in Liaoning Province. This paper is an interdisciplinary research of data statistics and financial management.

articleTitle: Research on the Effects of Female Executives on Business Performance based on Panel Threshold Regression Model : Differentiation Analysis of Three Main Industries in China Based on Panel Threshold Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Panel threshold regression model is a multi-interval regression test model constructed for the study of nonlinear relationships, characterized by automatically searching for one or more catastrophe points of research variables based on the sample data of the model. Thus, by using panel threshold regression model, this paper conducts an analysis on the optimal interval of the proportion of female executives promoting the corporate business performance. The study in this paper finds that the proportion of female executives has a significant threshold effect on the business performance. It has a significant positive effect on the business performance during the 11.7%-39.8% interval. The estimated results of three main industries indicate that there are obvious differences in the threshold effects of the proportion of female executives in different industries, which exerts positive effects on clarifying the status and importance of female executives in corporate governance as well as eliminating social gender differences in industrial structure.

articleTitle: Study of Intergenerational Mobility and Urbanization Based on OLS Method and Ordered Probit Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Recently the essential role of education attainment and intergenerational mobility in China raises attention because of its rapid economic growth and associated problems for past decades. Based on Stata/SE (15.1), this paper uses data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study (CHARLS) to compare the intergenerational education correlation among three generations on rural-urban, inland-coastal, and interprovincial base. In this paper, we analyze the CHARLS data set using the OLS method and the ordered Probit model. A longitudinal comparison shows how literacy and education in general improved along the spiraling economy in China. Nevertheless, both an international and a national cross-sectional comparison show a rural-urban gap in education and a tendency of rapidly increasing inequality which is further deepened by the educational persistence. The number of years of schooling or educational level of the children generation is positively correlated with that of the parents generation, while the intergenerational education level is fluctuated but on the rise.

articleTitle: A Model of Assessment and Minimization of CO2 Emissions for Green Hub Location-Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: With the growing concern regarding the environmental issues, it is necessary to consider the environmental performance of the freight transportation network, while keeping it economically competitive. This paper focuses on the Hub Location-Routing Problem (HLRP) and detects the carbon footprint with aims to figuring out ways to calculate and reduce the CO2 emissions. A MILP model was developed and a computational experiment is conducted to reveal the fact that the solutions of minimizing CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions tended to open more potential hubs, which then was subjected to a big network cost. Further experiments with an epsilon constraint method explored the trade-offs between the network cost and the CO2 emissions.

articleTitle: Executive Salary, Executive Power and Enterprise Innovation Intensity—Multiple regression analysis from equipment manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Earlier studies did not reach a unified conclusion on the influence of monetary compensation and the proportion of executive shareholding on innovation behavior, and did not consider the moderating effect of executive power. This paper uses 559 listed Chinese equipment manufacturing companies as the research object, and multiple regression analysis studies the relationship between executive compensation incentives and corporate innovation intensity and the impact of executive power on the relationship between the two. Empirical research has found that there is a positive correlation between executive monetary compensation and innovation intensity; there is an inverted U-shaped relationship between executive shareholding ratio and innovation intensity. Further analysis shows that executive power positively regulates the relationship between executive compensation and innovation intensity, that is, the greater the executive power, the stronger the positive relationship between monetary compensation and innovation intensity. The weaker the inverted U-shaped relationship between the strengths, the inverted U-shaped inflection point appears in a state where the shareholding ratio of executives is higher.

articleTitle: Research on Tesla’s Customer Care Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: At present, the new energy automobile industry is developing rapidly. Not only the traditional automobile enterprises are forced to develop new energy vehicles under the pressure of policies, but also a series of new forces have joined in building new vehicles. At present, the competition among new energy automobile enterprises in the market is fierce. How Tesla can stand out among all automobile enterprises, besides outstanding product innovation, personalized customer care is necessary. The external environment affects the company's strategic decision. In this study, PEST model and five forces model are used to analyze Tesla's external environment. As a newly emerging industry, the new energy automobile industry has good development opportunities. Secondly, this paper uses Porter's value chain model to analyze Tesla's internal environment and determine Tesla's strategic positioning. The data about Tesla in this study are collected from the official website, the annual report and the analysis of the company. Finally, on the basis of the above analysis, using the "customer journey analysis" combined with McKinsey's customer care strategy, this paper puts forward some strategic transformation suggestions on customer care for Tesla.

articleTitle: The Influence Relationship among Extrinsic Incentive, Intrinsic Motivation and Employee Innovation Performance based on Holmstrom and Milgrom model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Holmstrom-Milgrom model is a simplified model proposed for the purpose of simplifying analysis based on the general mathematical model of principal agent. In this study, the influence of intrinsic motivation and extrinsic incentive is fully taken into account, and the parametric principal-agent model is formed by parameter extension of the model. This model is used to conduct empirical study and verification on the relationship between extrinsic incentive, intrinsic motivation and employee innovation performance. The empirical results show that, intrinsic motivation is positively correlated with employee innovation performance, and extrinsic incentive is positively correlated with intrinsic motivation. In addition to the coordination relationship, other extrinsic incentives exert no significant and direct effect on employee innovation performance. The indirect effect of extrinsic incentive relies on the intrinsic motivation, which serves as an intermediary role and between extrinsic incentive and employee innovation performance. This study enriches the existing theoretical research and provides reference for enterprises to effectively implement incentive mechanism.

articleTitle: Based on the BPN and MARS model to discuss how hotels influence operational performance through intellectual capital
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Hotels are facing the greatest challenge since the outbreak of SARS and coronavirus disease, and researchers discovered that intellectual capital plays a crucial role at such times. This study applies the concept of artificial neural networks to investigate the effects of hotel intellectual capital with operating performances. This research select 145 international hotels listed in Asian countries' stock markets in the U.S. Compustat database to investigate the association between the value of intellectual capital and operating performances. This study proposes a two-stage construction procedure. First, The multivariate adaptive regression splines forecasting(MARS) results show that Z-score, Economic Added Value of Employees, Turnover Rate of Fixed Assets, Revenue Growth Rata, Turnover Rate of Accounts Receivable, and Employee Productivity play crucial roles in the intellectual capital dimension on operating performance. Second, the research use the obtained MARS variables as input variables of the back-propagation neural network model(MARS-BPN) not only to shorten the time required for model training but also provides a preferable prediction. The MARS-BPN forecasting has important implications for the implementation of appropriate operating performance decisions or strategies.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Industrial Structure of the Yellow River Basin on the Ecological Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin are major national strategies. Based on the output value of the three industries in the Yellow River Basin from 1991 to 2015 and the relevant data of the industrial "three wastes", VAR model, Johansen cointegration test and impulse response analysis were carried out to analyze the impact of changes in the industrial structure of the Yellow River Basin on the ecological environment. The results show: Firstly, the development of the primary industry in the Yellow River Basin causes little pollution to the ecological environment in both short-term and long-term and it has a negative relationship with the ecological environment. Secondly the secondary industry has a negative co-integration relationship with solid waste generation and industrial waste gas emissions in long-term, but it will bring about the deterioration of the ecological environment in the short term. Lastly, the tertiary industry in the Yellow River Basin can improve the water environment. Meanwhile it has a positive relationship with industrial waste gas emissions and solid waste generation, but the impact is greater small.

articleTitle: Research on the Industrial Coordinated Development of 17 Coastal Cities in the Bohai Rim Economic Circle Based on the Synergy Degree Model of Compound Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper divides the 17 coastal cities in the Bohai Rim Economic Circle into three subsystems based on their geographic location, using a composite system synergy model based on sequence parameters and using industry data from 17 coastal cities in the Bohai Rim Economic Circle from 2010 to 2019 to Calculate the order of development of these three subsystems' industries over the years and the degree of development synergy between the industries of each subsystem. The results of the study show that: from 2010 to 2019, the orderliness of the industrial development of the three subsystems of the Bohai Rim Economic Circle generally showed an upward trend, and all reached a relatively high level in 2019; in terms of the calculation results in 2019, the regional industrial subsystems of Shandong have the highest level of development, and the industrial coordination among the subsystems in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei-Shandong region is the highest.

articleTitle: Tests of CBOE Options Market Efficiency and Arbitrage Opportunities Based on Options Pricing Mathematical Models
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: This paper examines the efficiency of CBOE options market and potential arbitrage opportunities based on no-arbitrage principle and options pricing model. Results show that the efficiency of the options market is relatively high. Most of the mispricing can be fixed in 1 to 2 days. However, arbitrage opportunities still exist. Black-Scholes model and Put-call parity options pricing model are two mathematical models that can calculate the options price in a theoretical way. The average arbitrage duration in Black-Scholes model violation test is the longest. Arbitrage duration and profits are related to the liquidity of options. High arbitrage profits can be obtained from less liquid options. Arbitrage profits are high for put options.

articleTitle: Analysis on the influence of green trade barrier’s degree on Vegetable export in China based on gravity model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The United States, the European Union and most RCEP members are important vegetable importers of China. However, in recent years, against the background of anti-globalization, many countries have set up green trade barriers of different degrees for vegetable import. Trade gravity model is a theoretical hypothesis established by Newton's gravitation formula, which is used by economists to explain the problem of determining the flow of trade within a sector. This paper uses the time series data from 2000 to 2019, modifies the gravity model, and uses STATA 12.0 for regression to analyze the impact of the green trade barrier degree of China's main vegetable trade companies on China, and analyzes the changing trend of this influence. Based on the analysis results, we can see the influence of green trade barriers on China's vegetable products is expected to be further reduced, especially after the signing of the RCEP, so China's export will increase, but China's vegetable export direction is going to focus on the east area in the short term. We suggest that China comply with international standards, improve the supply chain and logistics system of agricultural products, enhance the international competitiveness of vegetable products and diversify trade directions.

articleTitle: The Strategy of the Mutual Promotion of Domestic and International Circulation of China: Analysis of Swot and Countermeasures and Suggestions
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: President Xi Jinping introduced the strategy of the mutual promotion of domestic and international circulation of China(Dual Circulation) On May 14, 2020. This paper integrates method of qualitative analysis with quantitative analysis to analyze the Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities and Threats(SWOT) of the "dual circulation" strategy in China. At the same time, Ordinary Least Square (OLS) function is used for regression analysis. The research shows that it is necessary to improve the development of high-tech industry and increase the number of patent applications for high-tech industry. The Chinese government and enterprises must stimulate consumption and improve people's consumption level. Finally, According to the SWOT of the "dual circulation" strategy, some countermeasures and suggestions are put forwared.

articleTitle: Impact of Customer Perceived Service Quality on Online Booking Decisions Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Perceived service quality effectively influences consumers' purchases and repeated purchases. How to improve the service quality and enhance the customer perceived value is not only a practical operational problem to be solved urgently by star-rated hotels, but also a hot topic that is closely concerned in the academic field. This paper used the structural equation modeling (SEM) analysis method to explore the impact mechanism of perceived service quality on online booking decisions of star-rated hotel customers, and proposed promotion strategies for online booking of star-rated hotels. The empirical analysis revealed that among all the factors that constitute the perceived service quality, safety (0.81) is the most important influencing factor, followed by remediation (0.79), empathy (0.78), and tangibility (0.53). Other factors in the categories of hotel characteristics, platform recommendation, and customer reviews influence online booking decision as well.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between technological innovation failure experience and innovation performance based on structural equation model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: Enterprises need to initiate innovation activities and open use of external knowledge resources in the process of new product development. In this paper, Amos structure equation model, Hierarchical regression and other mathematical / computer related models are used to conduct interdisciplinary research on the related issues of enterprise technological innovation. This paper aims to explore how the experience of new activity failure affects innovation performance and the role of two key dimensions of open innovation (external search scope and formal innovation collaboration scope). Through the establishment of structural equation model, using the survey data from Yangtze River Delta enterprises, this paper finds that the experience of innovation failure affects innovation performance through five mediating variables: innovation organization, innovation direction, innovation motivation, innovation knowledge accumulation, market and customer demand cognition. This process is positively regulated by the scope of external knowledge search, while the formal innovation collaboration breadth In this process, the regulation effect is not significant. Finally, some suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Financial Modeling Analysis of the Impact of Consumer Coupons on Economic Recovery after the Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: According to financial data so far, the COVID-19 pandemic poses a major threat to the global economy. As China's GDP growth in the first quarter reached an astonishing -6.8%, people can't help but worry that the global economy may repeat the entire history of the Great Depression. However, many policy makers place their hopes on consumer coupons. In this paper, through predictive analysis based on big data financial models, consumer coupons can stimulate consumption and promote economic recovery. This paper uses regression analysis to qualitatively and quantitatively study the impact of consumer vouchers on China’s post-pandemic recovery, and finds that consumer vouchers have a positive impact on consumption growth. The results of this model are consistent with reality, indicating that the mathematical model plays an important role in predicting the economy.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of Knowledge Sharing Model in Strategic Emerging Industry Alliance Cliques based on Knowledge Sharing Model
publicationTitle: 2020 Management Science Informatization and Economic Innovation Development Conference (MSIEID)
abstract: The knowledge sharing model is a game model which is constructed by comparing the relationship between income and cost and exploring the law of knowledge sharing among enterprises. On the one hand, the model considers the knowledge obtained by enterprises through alliance relationship, the knowledge spilled inside and outside the clique and the innovation output obtained by synergistic effect; On the other hand, it considers the cost that enterprises need to pay from finding, negotiating to choosing alliance cliques. Based on the knowledge sharing model, this paper tries to find the rules of knowledge sharing among the enterprises inside and outside the alliance cliques. The results show that when there is no synergistic effect of knowledge between enterprises in cliques, there is a free rider behavior when enterprises choose cliques; When there is synergy effect, enterprises have strong willingness to get more innovative knowledge to enhance their innovative potential; However, with the increase of the cost of enterprise alliance, the enthusiasm of enterprises to choose alliance cliques gradually decreases. Finally, based on the conclusions of the research, the paper puts forward some countermeasures and suggestions for enterprises to choose alliance cliques and improve innovation output.
